# Kapit - Unified Financial Data API for AI Agents
# https://kapit.dev

> One API key, one schema, multi-asset access. Built for autonomous AI agents.

## Overview

Kapit provides unified access to financial data across stocks, cryptocurrencies, and prediction markets. Designed for AI agent builders who need reliable data without juggling multiple upstream APIs.

## Base URL

https://api.kapit.dev

## Quick Start

1. Get a Kapit API key (kap_live_... for production or kap_test_... for testing)
2. Add `Authorization: Bearer kap_live_xxx` to every protected request
3. Start fetching data:

  curl https://api.kapit.dev/v1/stocks/quotes/AAPL \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer kap_live_xxx"

## Authentication

All endpoints require a Bearer token in the Authorization header:

  Authorization: Bearer kap_live_xxxxxxxx

- kap_live_* — production/live keys
- kap_test_* — test keys for development and smoke testing

No OAuth, no redirects, no CAPTCHAs. Designed for autonomous agents.

## Endpoints

### Stocks
GET /v1/stocks/quotes/{symbol}
- Returns real-time stock quote with price, change, volume
- Primary provider: FMP. Fallback: Twelve Data
- symbol: ticker symbol (e.g. AAPL, MSFT, TSLA)

### Crypto
GET /v1/crypto/prices/{symbol}
- Returns real-time crypto price with 24h change, market cap, supply data
- Provider: CoinGecko
- symbol: CoinGecko coin ID (e.g. bitcoin, ethereum, solana) — NOT ticker symbol

### Prediction Markets
GET /v1/polymarket/markets/{market_id}
- Returns single prediction market with outcomes, implied probabilities, volume, liquidity, order book, resolution status
- market_id: numeric ID or slug (e.g. bitcoin-all-time-high-by-september-30-2026)

### Usage
GET /v1/usage
- Returns current usage and rate limit status for the authenticated API key

## Response Envelope

Every endpoint returns KapitResponse[T]:

{
  "data": { ...asset-specific payload... },
  "meta": {
    "request_id": "req_...",
    "source": { "provider": "fmp", "primary_provider": "fmp", "fallback_used": false },
    "freshness": { "as_of": "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z", "is_stale": false, "is_delayed": false, "cache_ttl_seconds": 60 },
    "usage": { "cache": false },
    "rate_limit": { "limit": 1000, "remaining": 987, "reset_at": "2026-01-02T00:00:00Z", "tier": "starter" }
  }
}

Rate limit state is also returned in headers: X-RateLimit-Limit, X-RateLimit-Remaining, X-RateLimit-Reset

## Error Envelope

Every error returns KapitErrorResponse:

{
  "error": {
    "code": "rate_limited",
    "message": "Rate limit exceeded",
    "doc_url": "https://docs.kapit.io/errors/rate-limited.md",
    "is_retriable": true,
    "retry_after_seconds": 60,
    "param": null,
    "recovery": {
      "action": "wait_and_retry",
      "backoff_strategy": "fixed",
      "max_retries": 3,
      "retry_after_seconds": 60,
      "guidance": "You have exceeded your tier's request limit. Wait for the window to reset or upgrade your plan."
    },
    "context": {
      "method": "GET",
      "path": "/v1/stocks/quotes/AAPL",
      "status_code": 429,
      "rate_limit": { "limit": 100, "remaining": 0, "reset_at": "2026-05-14T00:00:00Z", "tier": "free" }
    }
  }
}

## Rate Limits

| Tier       | Daily Limit |
|------------|-------------|
| Free       | 100         |
| Starter    | 1,000       |
| Pro        | 10,000      |
| Enterprise | Custom      |

When rate limited (429), the response includes retry_after_seconds — wait this long before retrying.

## Error Recovery Decision Table

| Code                   | HTTP | Retriable | Recovery Action      | Backoff     |
|------------------------|------|-----------|----------------------|-------------|
| invalid_request        | 400  | No        | change_parameter     | none        |
| authentication_error   | 401  | No        | authenticate         | none        |
| permission_denied      | 403  | No        | upgrade_plan         | none        |
| rate_limited           | 429  | Yes       | wait_and_retry       | fixed       |
| symbol_not_found       | 404  | No        | change_parameter     | none        |
| market_not_found       | 404  | No        | change_parameter     | none        |
| not_found              | 404  | No        | change_parameter     | none        |
| upstream_error         | 502  | Yes       | wait_and_retry       | exponential |
| upstream_rate_limited  | 502  | Yes       | wait_and_retry       | fixed       |
| upstream_timeout       | 504  | Yes       | wait_and_retry       | exponential |
| upstream_bad_response  | 502  | Yes       | retry                | fixed       |
| internal_error         | 500  | Yes       | report_request_id    | exponential |
| unsupported_asset_class| 400  | No        | do_not_retry         | none        |

Key decision points for agents:
- Match on error.code (never error.message)
- Check error.recovery.action for the recommended recovery strategy
- When action is wait_and_retry, use recovery.retry_after_seconds and recovery.backoff_strategy
- When action is report_request_id, capture meta.request_id for support
- error.context.attempted_providers shows which upstream sources were tried

## Agent Usage Notes

- Always check meta.rate_limit.remaining before making batch requests
- Respect retry_after_seconds on 429 and 502 errors
- Match on error.code for programmatic switching — never parse error.message
- Follow error.recovery.action for automatic self-correction
- Use meta.freshness.is_stale to decide when to re-fetch
- Cache responses using meta.freshness.cache_ttl_seconds
- Do not retry non-retriable errors (400, 401, 403, 404) — fix the request instead
- Crypto symbol uses CoinGecko coin IDs (bitcoin) not tickers (BTC)
- Free-tier stock data may be 15 minutes delayed — check meta.freshness.is_delayed
